decisions.candidate: S1-1 CVE-2026-47291 Windows HTTP.sys pre-auth kernel RCE
decisions.rationale: CVE covered 2026-06-10 (June Patch Tuesday, patch disclosure only; store-wide dedup hit, >14d). In-window delta: ZDI full exploitation write-up 2026-07-10 (integer-overflow arithmetic + TLS-record-fragmentation trigger) materially lowers weaponization bar and yields a concrete network-detection concept. Ships as update_of delta, not fresh entry. Clears PD-11(d) substantive primary technical analysis improving detection on a pre-auth RCE on exposed Windows/IIS web tier (public-sector core).

decisions.candidate: S1-2 CVE-2026-41264 FlowiseAI CSV Agent unauth RCE
decisions.rationale: Underlying CVE April 2026 (out-of-window for the vuln); only in-window delta is a public Metasploit module for a niche self-hosted AI-agent platform with a speculative/indirect public-sector nexus and no confirmed ITW exploitation of this specific bypass CVE. Doubt about relevance-to-constituency resolves toward drop (PD-11).

decisions.candidate: S3-1 GigaWiper Golang destructive backdoor (Microsoft TI)
decisions.rationale: New destructive tradecraft (disk wiper + fake-ransomware + secure-wipe folded into one implant; RabbitMQ/Redis/MinIO C2), IRGC-adjacent code lineage (Crucio). Clears PD-11(d) with concrete low-false-positive hunt pivots; transferable to any Windows CI estate. Freshest source Infosec Mag 2026-07-10 (in-window). New entities: tool:gigawiper, tool:crucio-ransomware, tool:flockwiper.

decisions.candidate: S3-2 Friendly Fire prompt-injection RCE vs Claude Code / Codex CLI (AI Now)
decisions.rationale: Distinct third AI-coding-agent prompt-injection RCE mechanism in <2 weeks (not a dup of 0DIN/GhostApproval). Clears PD-11(d); actionable hardening for orgs adopting agentic AI code-review. Freshest source Infosec Mag 2026-07-10. references prior two entries. New entity: campaign:friendly-fire-ai-agent-defensive-hijack.

decisions.candidate: S3-3 GodDamn ransomware / PoisonX Microsoft-signed malicious kernel driver (Symantec)
decisions.rationale: Materially-evolved BYOVD TTP: a driver built malicious from the outset yet Microsoft-signed (WHCP), defeating code-signing allowlisting to blind EDR. Clears PD-11(d) + breach-gate(b). Concrete behavioral hunt (driver-load followed by security-service termination). Freshest source Infosec Mag 2026-07-10. New entities: actor:hyadina, tool:poisonx-driver.

decisions.candidate: S3-4 REF6045 / SCMBANKER ClickFix Mexican banking fraud (Elastic)
decisions.rationale: Freshest source 2026-07-08 (both Elastic + THN), ~72h old, outside the 24h window and not update/background/patched-ref. Victimology out-of-region (Mexico/LATAM retail banking); transferable ClickFix delivery-chain content is real but ClickFix already covered extensively as a technique. Weak constituency nexus + out-of-window -> drop.

decisions.candidate: S4-1 NHS England insider patient-record access guidance + incidents
decisions.rationale: Confirmed UK public-sector healthcare insider-access incidents (Nottingham: 11 dismissed; Cambridgeshire: ~40) with transferable EPR/EHR audit-analytics + break-glass detection lesson. Clears PD-11(c) home-region-adjacent (Europe/UK) public-sector-healthcare incident with operational lesson; transferable to Swiss cantonal hospital networks. Framed around detection/hardening, not the awareness campaign. Freshest source Infosec Mag 2026-07-10.

deep_dive_rationale: No candidate clears the deep-dive bar: no active ITW exploitation with constituency exposure; the strongest technical items (GigaWiper, GodDamn/PoisonX, Friendly Fire) are substantive but observed against out-of-region targets / are PoCs, not a full actionable kill chain against the constituency. deep_dives_today=0 in the snapshot; no manufactured depth.
